name: Timely
description_en:
Timely at gettimely.com is salon booking and payments software for hair and beauty businesses. It combines client appointments, staff calendars, deposits and client records; it should not be confused with unrelated time-tracking products using the same name.

The workflow extends past reserving a slot: treatment information, consultation forms, reminders and payment handling need to follow the correct client and staff member. Their availability depends on plan and region.
description_zh:
gettimely.com 的 Timely 是面向美发美容企业的沙龙预约及支付软件，结合客户预约、员工日历、订金和客户记录，不应与同名计时产品混淆。

流程不止预留时段：服务信息、咨询表、提醒及收款需跟随正确客户和员工，是否可用取决于套餐及地区。

core_features.explanation_en: Online bookings assign salon appointments to the relevant staff calendar.
core_features.explanation_zh: 线上预约将沙龙服务分配至相应员工日历。

core_features.name_zh: 套餐限定的咨询及候补
core_features.explanation_en: Elevate adds consultation forms, client files and waitlist; Innovate adds automatic forms.
core_features.explanation_zh: Elevate 增加咨询表、客户文件及候补，Innovate 增加自动表单。

en: Configure services, bookable staff, appointment durations and the intended payment/deposit policy. A client books a treatment; the salon checks the assigned staff member and required consultation information. Elevate lists digital forms and client documents, while automatic consultation forms appear in Innovate. Do not assume Build provides every form automation.

sections.title_en: Example: a consultation before a treatment
sections.en:
Configure services, bookable staff, appointment durations and the intended payment/deposit policy. A client books a treatment; the salon checks the assigned staff member and required consultation information. Elevate lists digital forms and client documents, while automatic consultation forms appear in Innovate. Do not assume Build provides every form automation.

Rehearse a cancellation, a waitlist request and an undelivered reminder before relying on the calendar. No salon account, deposit or message was created in this research.
sections.zh:
配置服务、可预约员工、时长及预期付款/订金政策。客户预约护理后，门店检查对应员工及所需咨询信息。Elevate 列有数字表及客户文件，自动咨询表出现在 Innovate，不能假定 Build 包含所有表单自动化。

依赖日历前应演练取消、候补请求及提醒未送达。本次未创建沙龙账户、订金或消息。

sections.title_en: Bookable staff, messages and payment geography
sections.title_zh: 可预约员工、消息与支付地域
sections.en:
The read pricing state selected Rest of the world and one bookable staff member. Build showed USD 26, Elevate USD 39 and Innovate USD 47 per staff per month, billed monthly, with 100/200/350 included SMS respectively. These are that selected market and staff count, not universal salon totals. The FAQ charges part-time staff at the same rate as full-time staff and adjusts the plan for team size.

Included SMS renew on the billing date; excess messages incur the applicable SMS rate. Included SMS exclude UAE, Ghana, Saudi Arabia and Qatar, and campaigns have a narrower country list. Payments are advertised only in Australia, New Zealand, USA, UK and most EU countries; processing fees remain separate. Verify the exact country and payment rate before purchase.
sections.zh:
实读价格状态选择“世界其他地区”和一位可预约员工。Build、Elevate、Innovate 分别显示每员工每月 26、39、47 美元，按月计费，分别含 100/200/350 条短信。这是该市场及员工数的价格，不是通用门店总价。FAQ 说明兼职与全职员工同费率，并随团队规模调整套餐。

包含短信在账单日刷新，超出按适用短信费率收费。阿联酋、加纳、沙特及卡塔尔不含短信，营销短信地域更少。支付只宣传在澳大利亚、新西兰、美国、英国及多数欧盟地区可用，处理费另计；采购前需核实具体国家及支付费率。

sections.title_en: Match the service workflow before migrating clients
sections.title_zh: 迁移客户前匹配服务流程
sections.en:
A salon with staff-specific services can evaluate the combined booking/client workflow. Teams outside supported payment regions or needing different resource rules should confirm those requirements rather than infer worldwide feature parity. The official trial is 14 days with no card required; it is not a permanent free plan.

No import, access permissions, refunds, SMS delivery, tax treatment, software licence or self-hosting rights were verified. Public browser reads resolved the earlier JavaScript-shell issue; they do not constitute a hands-on product test.
sections.zh:
具有按员工区分服务的门店可评估预约与客户流程。处于支付支持地域以外，或需要不同资源规则的团队，应核实需求，不能推断各地功能相同。官方试用 14 天且无需信用卡，并非永久免费套餐。

未核实导入、访问权限、退款、短信送达、税务处理、软件许可或自托管权。公共浏览器实读解决了先前 JavaScript 空壳问题，不构成产品实测。

research_gaps.zh: 具体本地费用、营销短信地域、导入、权限及支付/退款行为需账户验证。
